decisions.title: Decide how Metsera §5.7 linked-duty / item-42 shared-source rows (rights survival and no-adverse-amendment) should appear in the sealed D&O inventory.
decisions.plain_english_question: How should Metsera’s §5.7 linked D&O duties (rights survival and no-adverse-amendment) appear in the sealed D&O inventory — as approved child profiles, kept deferred with a policy amendment, or folded into the parent charter-continuation proposition?
decisions.background: Five Metsera D&O rows remain HOLD with item-42 linked-duty deferral. The sealed contract policy still pins the item-42 shared source to PROFILE keys RIGHTS_SURVIVAL and NO_ADVERSE_AMENDMENT, but those profiles are withheld from the approved inventory, so on-disk full-set Work3 validation fails (Blocker B). D&O Q01 preferred reading treats coordinated linked duties as roles or children on one operative proposition rather than silently omitting them. Dimension-evidence rows for those child profiles were dropped when HOLDs were respected and return only if the HOLD lifts.
decisions.what_is_already_sealed: 26 of 31 D&O profiles are APPROVE. Milestone A family package is on disk; Blocker A (per-profile fixture proofs) is closed. The lawful-fixture dimension-evidence defect on the parent charter-continuation profile was fixed and re-sealed. Q01–Q03 programme rulings for D&O are recorded; they do not by themselves approve item-42 linked-duty shape.
decisions.why_it_matters: Five Metsera rows are HOLD, and Blocker B blocks on-disk full-set Work3 validation because the sealed contract policy pins the item-42 shared source to two profiles the approved inventory withholds.
